m100007.――ええッ！？\n謁見って、話合いじゃないんですか！？\n魔界では何を得るにも戦: —W-What!? An audience is supposed to be a discussion! So in the Demon Realm you have to fight to get anything…?
m100007.――ここが協力者と落ち合う予定の\n奴隷地区なんだが……おい、どうした。\nもた: ――So this is the slave district where we're supposed to meet our allies… Hey, what's the hold-up? If we dawdle, the demons will find us.
m100007.――この地形の特徴……待ち合わせ場所は\nこの辺りのようですが……。: —The terrain's features... It seems the meeting point is around here...
m100007.――っと。見ろよ、オークのおっさん。\nどうやら奴さん、現れたようだぜ。: —— Look, old Orc. Seems like that guy just showed up.
m100007.――ひとまず、敵は退けたようですが……。: —It looks like we've pushed the enemies back for now…
m100007.――ケラウノス様、準備は整いました。\nもう間もなく、人間達はここを通る筈です。: ――Lord Keraunos, preparations are complete. Soon the humans will pass through here.
m100007.――レヴィアタンの体内に続く入り口は\nこの先の筈…………っ！？ \nな、なんだ: —The entrance leading inside Leviathan should be just ahead…! Wh-what are those things!?
m100007.――天使達は退けたようです。: —It looks like the angels have been driven back.
m100007.――我々に抵抗を続ける人間共が、\nここに近づいているとの事だ。\n見つけ次第殺: —The humans who keep resisting are drawing near. Kill them on sight, Hansel.
m100007.――落ち着いてください皆さん、\n我々は皆さんと戦いに来たわけでは！: —Calm down, everyone. We didn't come here to fight you!
m100007.…………そんな。\nデーモンのみが存在する世界だなんて……。: …No… A world inhabited only by demons…?
m100007.……ここならデーモンの目は届かないか。: ...Here, the demon's eyes can't reach us.
m100007.……こほん。魔界の深層ではただ瘴気が\n濃くなるだけではないぞ。なんでも――: …Ahem. In the Demon Realm's depths, it's not just the miasma that intensifies. Supposedly—
m100007.……そうなれば、後に残るのは虚無のみとなる。: …If that comes to pass, only void will remain.
m100007.……それこそがデーモンの本懐。: …That is the true desire of demons.
m100007.……どうやらネヴィンの見立ては正しかったようだな。\n合格だ、王子よ。貴様の力は: …It seems Nevin's assessment was correct. You've passed, Prince. Your strength is enough to satisfy even my heart.
m100007.……ま、まぁ「謁見」って言っても、ここは魔界だ。\nアンタらの思ってるものとは違: …Well, an “audience” or whatever, this is still the Demon Realm. It might not be what you expect, so brace yourself for the Demon-realm style.
m100007.……まだ誰も来ていないようですね。\n顔も名も判らぬ以上、ひとまずここで\n待つ: ...No one's arrived yet. Since we don't know their faces or names, we have no choice but to wait here for now.
m100007.……やれやれ、やっとわしの出番が来たわい。\nさぁ王子、戦闘の指示を頼むぞい！: …Good grief, finally my turn has come. Come on, Prince, give me the battle orders!
m100007.……よかろう。\nならばこの女王ドロテア、自らが相手をしてやる。: …Very well. Then I, Queen Dorothea, will deal with you myself.
m100007.……よく判んないけど、\nアタシが魔界にいる間に、\n物質界でも色々あったんだね: I don't really get it, but while I've been in the demon realm, a lot's happened in the material world too.
m100007.……アイツを解放してやるためにも、\nどうかレヴィアタンの心臓を破壊して、\nデ: …To free him, please destroy Leviathan's heart and crush the demons' scheme.
m100007.……デーモンメイジ様、お言葉ですが\nここ最近デーモン様方の御遊びの相手にと、\: …Demon Mage, if I may, lately many slaves have been taken as your… amusements and haven't returned.
m100007.……分かりました。\n王子、ここは彼を信じることにしましょう。\nそれではネヴィ: …Understood. Prince, let's trust him. Then, Nevin, please lead the way.
m100007.……王子、ここは一旦\n戦って切り抜けるしかなさそうです！\nご指示をお願いしま: ...Prince, it looks like we have to fight our way through here! Await your orders!
m100007.……確かに、貴方の仰る通り、魔界の者と\n手を組めば私達にとってもメリットがあり: …Indeed, as you say, allying with the denizens of the Demon Realm would also bring us advantages.
m100007.……身の程を弁えぬ発言、\n失礼しました。\n全ては主の仰せのままに。: …My apologies for overstepping. Everything will be done as you command.
m100007.……魔界流。\n嫌な予感がします……。: …Demon-realm style. I've got a bad feeling about this…
m100007.……！ 王子、向こうからデーモン達が！: …! Prince, demons are coming from over there!
m100007.「謁見」か……緊張すんなぁ。女王様なんて人種は\n滅多に近くで見られねぇからな…: An audience, huh… Don't get nervous. We rarely get to see the queen up close… Alright, I'll dazzle her with my heroic tales!
m100007.あ、お待ちください！ 闇雲に進んでも、\n迷子になってしまいます！\n行き先は私: Ah, please wait! If we just rush ahead, we'll get lost! Leave the navigation to us, the residents of the magical city.
m100007.あぁ、その通りさ。それを止める手段は一つだけ。\n……簡単な話だよ、レヴィアタン: Yeah, that's exactly it. There's only one way to stop it. …It's simple—defeat Leviathan and shut down its activity.
m100007.あぁ、アンタ等にはこの瘴気は少しキツいか。\nこっから先はさっきまでの表層とは違: Ah, this miasma is a bit harsh for you lot. From here on out it's not the same as the surface we just left—after all, we're deep in the Demon Realm.
m100007.あとは『ダークエレメンタル』とかもだな。\n奴らの攻撃には装甲も魔法への耐性も意: And then there are the Dark Elementals… Their attacks ignore both armor and magic resistance, so it's best to take them out before they get us… Oops, this isn't good.
m100007.あの容貌……恐らくは深層に住まう\n魔物の一種『ワーラット』かと。: Its appearance... It's probably a type of deep-dwelling monster called a “War Rat.”
m100007.あれは……まさかこのような所にまで\n天使達の手が迫っているとは……。: That… I never imagined the angels' reach would extend even here…
m100007.あれは天使です……人々を滅ぼさんとする\n……神の御使いです。: Those are angels… they're… the divine messengers intent on wiping out humanity.
m100007.い、一体何だってんだ。: W-what on earth is going on?
m100007.いちいち武器を構えんなって。\nつまりは、この地面こそがレヴィアタンだって事さ。: No need to draw your weapons. In other words, the ground itself is Leviathan. The Demon Realm sits on his back.
m100007.いつデーモン達の追撃があるかもわかりません。\nこのままここに留まり続けるのは危: We have no idea when the demons will counter-attack. Staying here any longer seems dangerous.
m100007.お、おいおい、こんなバカみたいなデカブツを\nぶっ倒すだと！ んな事、出来るわけ: W-wait, you think we can just smash that huge, stupid behemoth? There's no way we could!
m100007.おい、ダークエルフ。\n地上で抵抗を続けている猛者どもが、\nここへやってくると: Hey, dark elf. The tough ones still resisting on the surface are really coming here, huh?
m100007.おい、ネヴィン！ 誰だそいつらは？\n地上界の人間のように見えるが。\n――ハッ: Hey, Nevin! Who are those guys? They look like surface humans. —Huh!? Could they be the ones from that… plan?
m100007.おいおい、そんな怖い顔するなって。\nアンタらは、地上で魔界のデーモン達に\n抵: Hey, hey, don't make that scary face. You guys are the humans resisting the Demon Realm's demons on the surface, right?
m100007.おいおい、確かにダークエルフとオークは仲が\nいいわけじゃないが、今アンタ達オー: Hey, hey, sure, dark elves and Orcs aren't exactly friends, but what's in it for us if we fight you Orcs now?
m100007.くっ……強い！！ \n今は引くしかないが、次は必ず……！\n全軍撤退……！: Damn… strong!! I have to retreat for now, but next time I'll…! Full retreat!
m100007.ここが俺達ダークエルフが住んでいる区域だ。\nちょっと待っててくれ。女王に「謁見: This is the area where we Dark Elves live. Hold on a sec—I need to request an audience with the queen.
m100007.ここが魔界……ですか。 \n何だか空気が重いような気がします。: So this is the Demon Realm...? I feel like the air is unusually heavy.
m100007.ここが魔界都市ですか……。: Is this the Demon Realm city…?
m100007.この魔界がレヴィアタンの背中にある事は\n聞いていると思う。そして、魔界……レヴ: I'm sure you've heard that this demon realm sits on Leviathan's back—and that Leviathan is drawing ever closer to the material world.
m100007.さあ武器を取るが良い、地上界の者達よ。\nこの謁見を経ても尚、立っていることが出: Take up your weapons, denizens of the surface. If after this audience you can still stand, I'll tell you what you desire.
m100007.しかし、こんな所にまで人間を招いてしまうとは。\nガリウスは全く使えませんね。こ: But to think I'd invite humans all the way here… Garius is completely useless. This defeats the purpose of installing them on the Demon King's throne.
m100007.しかし、魔界の住人である我等は表立って\n行動する事が出来ぬ。デーモンに露呈して: However, as residents of the Demon Realm we cannot act openly. If we reveal ourselves as demons, our very race will inevitably be annihilated.
m100007.しかし本当に宜しかったのですか。\nアイギス様はケラウノス様の妹神では。\nそれ: But… are you sure this is right? Isn't Aegis your sister deity? And that… on Adamant's body…
m100007.しっかし、陰気臭い都市だな……。\n見ろよ、あれ。骸骨のモニュメントだぜ？\n…: Man, what a gloomy city… Look at that, a skeleton monument? …Even for bad taste, that's excessive.
m100007.す、すみません、少しお待ち頂ければ。\n先ほどから、進めば進むほど\n身体が重く: S-sorry, could you wait a moment? The farther we go, the heavier my body feels…
m100007.そ、そんなぁ……。\nやっぱり、戦いになってしまうのですね……。: N-no… So it really has to become a battle…
m100007.そう。そして、破壊により新生する\n次の世界においては、デーモンのみが存在する\: Exactly. And through destruction a new world will be born, a true Demon Realm inhabited solely by demons.
m100007.そういう事です。 \nでは、魔界の都市を目指して進みましょう。 \n数刻程進んだ: Exactly. Then let's press on toward the Demon Realm's city. The first city should be a few hours' walk ahead!
m100007.そういえば、リエーレさんは何故魔界に？: By the way, Riele, why are you in the demon realm?
m100007.そうだな……この辺りで言えば\n高い攻撃力を持つ『魔界ボア』には注意だな。\n半: Right… Around here, watch out for the high-damage ‘Demon Boar'. With weak defenses, it'll crush you in a single blow.
m100007.そうだな……それじゃあ、アンタらが\n欲しがってるであろう情報を教えてやるよ。\: …Alright then… I'll give you the info you're after. Yeah, the details on the demon god Leviathan.
m100007.そうですよ。この日の為に随分魔界について\n調査したのですから！: That's right. We've done a lot of research on the Demon Realm just for this day!
m100007.そうですよ～！ 同じ人間同士、\n話合いましょう！: That's right! We're all humans—let's talk it out!
m100007.そうとも言えませんよ。魔界は、私達が住む\n地上界とは生きる環境が違うだけで、\: That's not entirely true. The Demon Realm simply has a different environment from our surface world, and the species that have adapted live normally here.
m100007.そのような入口が……時は一刻を争います。\n早速案内をお願いできますか！: An entrance like that… Time is of the essence. Can you guide us right away?
m100007.そりゃあ、そうだろうよ。\nなにせここは魔界なんだぜ？\n俺ら人間にとっちゃ悪気: Well, that's to be expected. After all, this is the Demon Realm, right? To us humans, it's nothing but trouble.
m100007.そりゃそうだ。\nなんせ魔神レヴィアタンは、ほら……。\nアンタらの足元にいるん: Of course. After all, Leviathan's right there… literally under your feet.
m100007.そりゃ危険だろうよ。ひどい傷を負って\n戻ってきた事もある。それでもアイツは、\: Of course it's dangerous. I've come back with terrible wounds before. Still, he kept spying for this very chance.
m100007.それに、ここ魔界で私達には\n他に選択肢もないでしょう。: Moreover, here in the Demon Realm we have no other options.
m100007.それに、魔界の支配階級のデーモン族以外は、\nあまり良い思いをしてないようです。: Moreover, aside from the ruling demon class, the others don't seem to have it so good.
m100007.ただその入り口はデーモンの中でも極一部、\n高位デーモンにしか知らされていなかっ: Only a tiny fraction of the highest demons even know the entrance to that route… but we've finally pinpointed it.
m100007.だからこそ、地上界の者達と手を結びたいのだ。\nどうだろう、王子？ 魔界のダーク: That's why we wish to forge an alliance with those of the surface world. What do you think, Prince? The aid of the Demon Realm's Dark Elves would be of great benefit to you as well.
m100007.つまり、全てが無に帰したとしても\nデーモンは精神だけを残すことができる……と？: So even if everything returns to nothing, the demons can keep their spirits… is that it?
m100007.とは言えアンタらには神器の力がある。\n王子の傍にいる限り、大きな影響もないだろ: That said, you have the power of the relics. As long as you stay by the Prince's side, the impact should be minimal, and your bodies will adapt quickly.
m100007.とりあえずこの先にあるダークエルフの\n居住区へ来いよ。\nそこで俺達の女王から: For now, head to the Dark Elf settlement ahead. Our queen will fill you in on the details.
m100007.どなたか、私たちの話を聞いてくれる方が\nいるといいのですが……。\nあっ！ 見: I wish someone would listen to us… Ah! Look, Prince, it's an Orc!
m100007.なるほど、ここが魔法都市の文献にあった……\n……ふむ、ではせん越ながら『魔界深: I see, this is the place mentioned in the magical city's records… …Hmm, then allow me to speak on the ‘Demon Realm's Depths'…
m100007.なるほど、確かに、魔界で内戦が勃発すれば、 \n内にも外にも敵を作る事になります: I see. Indeed, if a civil war broke out in the Demon Realm, we'd end up making enemies both inside and out. That's strategically undesirable.
m100007.なんじゃと……。だが、それが真実なら理屈が通る。\n魔神レヴィアタンの活動が始ま: So… if that's true, it makes sense. Leviathan's activity means the Demon Realm is drawing closer to the surface.
m100007.なんでも表層では現れなかった、\n強力な魔物達が住まうとも……。: Supposedly there are powerful monsters here that never appear on the surface…
m100007.なんとか勝てたな。\nしっかし、魔界で戦うのは骨が折れるぜ。\nさて、先へ進もう: We managed to pull through. Fighting in the Demon Realm really takes a toll. Now, let's keep moving forward.
m100007.は、話合い！？\n急に襲ってきたのはそちらの方だというのに、\n一体どういうつも: A talk!? You just ambushed us, and now you want to talk… what are you thinking!?
m100007.はい……ということは、貴方が？: Yes... so that means, you are?
m100007.はい、ネヴィンさんの案内が受けられないのは\n不安ではありますが……ひとまず\n: Yes, it's unsettling not to have Nevin's guidance, but… let's press on for now.
m100007.はっ、デーモンメイジ様。\n……しかし何故デーモンメイジ様自ら\nこのような場所:
Yes, Demon Mage.
…But why are you, Demon Mage, coming to a place like this yourself?
m100007.はは……本当に強いなアンタら。降参だよ。\nもう抵抗はしない。俺はネヴィンだ。\: Ha ha… you really are strong. I surrender. I won't resist any longer. I'm Nevin. Let's have a talk.
m100007.ふむ……ネヴィンの推挙する程ならばと\n期待していたが、一見して、思ったほどの\: Hmm… If Nevin recommends them, I had high hopes, but at first glance I don't sense the vigor I expected.
m100007.ふん……。\nこの区域は、お前らダークエルフの本拠地に近い。\n俺達オークを謀り: Hmph... This area's close to your dark-elf stronghold. We Orcs could plot and catch you off guard.
m100007.へぇ、物質界の人間にしては良く知ってるな。\nその通り、こっから先の深層じゃ、魔: Heh, you humans know a lot for mortals. Exactly, once we go deeper, the demon miasma becomes incomparably stronger than what we just experienced.
m100007.ほう……確かに地上界の人間のようだな。\nここまで辿り着くとは、相当の手練れと見: Hmm… certainly looks like a surface human. To make it this far, you must be quite skilled. Interesting! I'll test that power right away!
m100007.ま、そんなとこだ。\nかなり見込みはあると思うぜ。\nさっそく女王ドロテア様に「: Yeah, that's about right. I think they've got a lot of potential. Let's go ask Queen Dorothea for an audience right away.
m100007.ま、待ってください！ 私達はこの地で\n一体どなたに会えば良いのでしょう！: Wait, please! Who are we supposed to meet here?
m100007.ま、魔界まで無くなっちまうだってッ！？\nおいおい、それじゃあ本末転倒じゃねえか: Wh-What, even the Demon Realm would disappear!? That's absurd! What on earth are those demons trying to do by reviving him!?
m100007.まぁ、答えなくてもいいさ。\nさっきの強さを見て、確証は得た訳だしな。: Well, you don't have to answer. I saw your strength earlier, so I've got what I need.
m100007.まずは、魔界に複数ある都市に向かいましょう。\nそこで、レヴィアタンの情報が\n: First, let's head to one of the cities within the Demon Realm. We might be able to gather information on Leviathan there.
m100007.み、見つかってしまいました……\n……？ なんでしょう、\nあのネズミのような魔: I—I've been discovered... ...? What is that rat-like monster...
m100007.もちろん、ダークエルフやオークといった \nある一定の数と力を持つ種族には、デー: Of course, demons can't easily lay a hand on races like dark elves or orcs, who have a certain number and strength.
m100007.もちろん、我等ダークエルフもその様なものなど\n望むわけがない……。だからこそ\: Of course, we Dark Elves have no desire for such a thing… That's precisely why we must stop the revival of the demon god Leviathan.
m100007.もちろん、魔界そのものに慣れた者ならば、 \nこの瘴気なんてものともしないのです: Of course, those accustomed to the Demon Realm wouldn't even notice such a miasma.
m100007.もちろんだ。ただ、僕は引き続き\nデーモン達の動向を探る必要がある。\nリエーレ: Of course. But I still need to keep tracking the demons. Riele, I'm sorry, but I'm counting on you to handle them.
m100007.もちろん外から幾ら攻撃しても無意味さ。\nけど、内側からなら……レヴィアタンの体: Of course, pounding it from the outside is pointless. But from the inside… if we get into Leviathan's body and destroy its heart directly, its activity should cease.
m100007.よくぞここまで辿り着いた、地上界の者たちよ。\n私がダークエルフの女王ドロテアで: Well done making it this far, surface dwellers. I am Dorothea, queen of the Dark Elves.
m100007.アタシは元々傭兵稼業の根無し草さ。\n色々な所を渡り歩いてる内に、\n気付けば魔: I'm just a rootless mercenary, wandering from place to place. Before I knew it, I got lost and ended up here.
m100007.アンタが地上界の猛者を倒せば、種族内で昇格。\n俺はそいつらの力を見定めたい。\: If you take down the surface's tough ones, you'll rise in your own race. I want to gauge their strength. A perfect give-and-take, right?
m100007.ケラウノス様、どうやら人間達が来たようです。\n精神体とはいえ、魔界に長居されて: Lord Keraunos, it seems the humans have arrived. Even as spirits, lingering in the demon realm could harm your body. Leave this to me.
m100007.デーモン……！！\n総員、至急隊列を整えて下さい！: A demon...!! Everyone, form up in battle formation immediately!
m100007.ヘンゼルさん……デーモンメイジの下で\n密偵をしているとの事ですが。\n危険では: Hansel… I heard he's spying under a demon mage. Isn't that dangerous?
m100007.レヴィアタンが動くには莫大なエネルギーを\n必要とする。そのエネルギーの糧を運ぶ: Leviathan needs an enormous amount of energy to move. It's said there's a route that carries that energy straight to its heart.
m100007.レヴィアタンが完全に復活すると、\n物質界を食い尽くすばかりか、\nこの魔界もろ: When Leviathan fully revives, it won't just devour the material world; it'll return this demon realm to void as well… right?
m100007.レヴィアタンの心臓を破壊……しかし、\n体内に入るなど……そのような事が\n可能: Destroy Leviathan's heart… but getting inside… is that even possible?
m100007.レヴィアタン復活の時は近い。くれぐれも\n邪魔だてされぬよう、ここで奴らを排除し: Leviathan's revival is near. Make sure nothing gets in the way; eliminate them here. Contact me immediately if anything comes up.
m100007.ワーラットは強力な疫病を宿しているとの事です。\n近づけば汚染され、痛手を負う事: War Rats are said to carry a potent plague. If you get close you'll be contaminated and take serious damage. Please be careful when you encounter them!
m100007.了解、コイツらの事は任せといてくれ。\nさぁ王子とやら、時間がないんだろ。\nレ: Got it, leave those guys to me. Come on, Prince, we don't have much time. The entrance to Leviathan is this way—follow me!
m100007.人の身でありながら、女神アイギスの加護だけでなく、\nその神器すらも使いこなすと: To think you, a mortal, can wield not only Aegis's divine protection but also its sacred relic… Impressive.
m100007.人間達がまさかこれ程力をつけているとは。\n天界に戻り、主にご報告しなければ……: The humans have grown far stronger than I expected. I must return to the heavens and report to my master…
m100007.仰るとおり、魔界には特殊な瘴気が満ちています。\nその為、我々地上界に住む者は普: As you said, the Demon Realm is saturated with a unique miasma. Because of that, we who dwell on the surface can't fully exert our usual strength here...
m100007.何が待ち受けているか判りません。\nくれぐれも慎重に進みましょう。: We don't know what awaits us. Let's proceed very carefully.
m100007.余計な話は無用……とでも言いたげだな。\n分かっている。今度は我々が其方達の信服: You'd rather skip the pleasantries, huh? I understand. Now it's our turn to earn your trust. Let me tell you about the demon god Leviathan.
m100007.侵入者だ！ 奴隷達よ、ワーラットを解き放て！\nデーモン様に逆らう愚かな人間達に: Intruders! Slaves, release the war rats! Bring down the hammer of death on those foolish humans who defy the Demon!
m100007.俺の目には、計画遂行に足る力の持ち主と映りました。\n……あとはドロテア様がどう: To me they appear to have the power needed to carry out the plan… The rest is up to you, Lady Dorothea, to decide.
m100007.僕の名はヘンゼル。デーモン達の動向を探る為、\nデーモンメイジの下で働いている…: My name is Hansel. I'm working under the Demon Mage to investigate the demons' movements... Anyway, no time for a long chat, let's keep it brief.
m100007.分かった、すぐにドロテア様に申し伝えよう。: Got it, I'll let Dorothea know immediately.
m100007.地上界を、食い尽くす……？\nそ、そんな事が起こり得るのでしょうか？: Devour the surface world…? Could something like that really happen?
m100007.奴隷地区……デーモン達に\n奴隷にされた者の住まう地区か。: Slave district… the area where those enslaved by demons live.
m100007.安心しな、話は既につけてある。\nあとはこのメモの場所に向かってくれ。\nそれじ: Don't worry, we've already arranged it. Just head to the spot marked on this note. Now, do your best!
m100007.定命の者は滅びるが、デーモンだけは別。\n私達が目にしているデーモンの肉体は仮の: Mortals perish, but demons are different. The bodies we see are merely temporary vessels; they only house their spirits.
m100007.実は、ヤツの復活までは、あまり猶予がない。\nもしそうなれば、間違いなく\nレヴ: In truth, we don't have much time before his revival. If it happens, Leviathan will surely devour the entire surface world.
m100007.我らデーモン以外の種は本当に脆弱すぎるな。\nあの程度の事で壊れ、使い物にならな: Those species besides demons are truly too fragile. They crumble and become useless over such trivial matters... Well, I suppose there's nothing we can do about it.
m100007.我ら高位デーモンに召集がかかっている。\n用があるのはこの先だ、どうせ通るなら暇: The high-rank demons have been summoned. Whatever we need is ahead; since we're passing through, I thought I'd bring a slave along for sport.
m100007.手荒な事をしてすまない。デーモン達の目がある中、\n堂々と君達と接触する訳にはい: Sorry for the rough approach. With the demons watching, I couldn't just meet you openly. You're the collaborators in the plan, the princes, right?
m100007.抵抗を続ける人間達がきた際、これ以上\n奴隷の数が少なくなっていてはいささか不安: When more resisting humans arrive, I'm a bit worried the slave count will get too low. After all, they're only useful as disposable pawns.
m100007.文献によれば、魔界の奥深く、\n魔界の深層では表層よりも遥かに\n瘴気が濃くなっ: According to the texts, deep within the Demon Realm, the miasma is far denser than on the surface.
m100007.準備は万全のようですね。人間に与する愚かなアイギスに、\nその行為がどれほど愚か: Your preparations seem flawless. Let the foolish Aegis who aids humans learn, through the deaths of the blessed, just how foolish their actions are.
m100007.焦るなってオークのおっさん。\n俺が魔界の掟を破るとでも思ってんのかよ？: Don't get antsy, you old Orc. You think I'm gonna break the Demon Realm's rules?
m100007.王子、ついに魔界に到着しましたね。: Prince, we've finally arrived in the Demon Realm.
m100007.王子、先ほど説明した通り、\n魔界の瘴気の影響で、兵達は\n思うように動けません: Prince, as I explained earlier, the miasma here hampers our troops' movements. Please command with caution!
m100007.王子、至急戦闘の準備をお願いします！！: Prince, please prepare for battle immediately!!
m100007.王子、負けられない理由が増えましたね。\nレヴィアタンを倒し、\n必ずやデーモン:
Prince, you've got even more reasons not to lose.
Let's take down Leviathan and be sure to thwart the demons' plans!
m100007.王子、魔界の瘴気に適応する者達であれば、\n濃い瘴気の影響で物質界以上の力を発揮: Prince, those who adapt to the demon realm's miasma can wield power beyond the material world under its thick influence. I recommend relying on their strength!
m100007.私が直接力を行使できれば、あのような者\n使わずとも良かったのですが。この瘴気の: If I could wield my power directly, I wouldn't need to use someone like that. In this miasma, even communicating as a spirit is barely possible.
m100007.私の力を分け与えた新鋭天使の力を使えば、\n人間など造作もない筈です。\n良い報: With the power of the new elite angels I bestowed, humans should be nothing to me. I'm looking forward to good news.
m100007.行く当てもなかった所をヘンゼルに助けられ、\n奴隷地区で身を隠し生活してたってわ: I was rescued by Hansel when I had nowhere to go, and I've been hiding out in the slave district ever since.
m100007.行ってしまいました。\n……っ！ 王子、デーモン達が\nこちらに気付いたようです:
They've gone.
…! Prince, the demons seem to have noticed us!
m100007.警戒するのもいいが、度が過ぎると機を逃すぞ。\nここは魔界だ。地上とは勝手が違う: Being cautious is fine, but overdoing it will cost you the chance. This is the Demon Realm—different rules than the surface. Wander around without purpose and the demons will surround you and finish you off.
m100007.賢明な判断に感謝する、地上界の者達よ。: I appreciate your wise decision, people of the surface.
m100007.連中自らこんな奴隷地区に見回りに来るとはな。\nすまねぇ、アンタらと一緒にいるの: They actually come to patrol this slave district themselves. Sorry, I can't have you seen with them, so my guide ends here.
m100007.魔界になんて、慣れたくもねぇな……。\n――ん？ あっちから何か向かってくるぞ？: I have no desire to get used to the Demon Realm... — Huh? Something's coming from over there!
m100007.魔界の住人か……。\nヘッ、ろくでもねぇ輩しかいねえんだろ、どうせ。: The denizens of the Demon Realm, huh... Heh, it's probably just a bunch of worthless scum, as usual.
m100007.魔界の奴らも一枚岩ではないってことか。: So even the Demon Realm's folk aren't a united front.
m100007.魔神レヴィアタンとは全てを無に帰す存在だ。\nヤツの復活は地上界だけでなく\n魔: The demon god Leviathan is an entity that returns everything to nothing. His resurrection would mean not only the surface world's end, but the annihilation of the Demon Realm itself.
m100007.魔神レヴィアタン！？\nご存じなのですか……？: Leviathan…? You actually know about it?
m100007.（――……行ったか。\nしかし、上空にはフライデーモンの監視の目。\nこのまま彼: (—... They've gone. But up above, the Friday Demon is watching. We can't just make contact like this... That thing!)
m100007.（……ここに来たという事は恐らく彼らが……\nだがデーモンの目がある以上、見逃す: (...Since they've come here, they're probably... But with the demon's eyes everywhere, we can't just let them slip by... It can't be helped.)
m100007.（こりゃすげぇや……！\nまさか、あの戦闘狂のオーク達を退けるとはな。\nへへっ: (This is amazing…! To think I'd push back those battle-crazy Orcs. Heh, this is getting fun.)

m200560.──学園でエッグパーティを開きたい、ですか。: —We want to hold an egg party at the academy, right?
m200560.『リトルレディは、彼女を虐げた国を存在ごと消し去った。\nそこに国があったという:
“Little Lady erased the nation that oppressed her, wiping it from existence.
She wouldn't even allow the fact that a country once stood there.
Perhaps our memory is the only trace left.”
m200560.『彼らは本当に実在していたのだろうか？\n今となっては、それを証明する手立てもな:
“Did they really exist?
Now there's no way to prove it.”
m200560.あたしね、この学園が大好き。: You know, I love this academy.
m200560.あるいは、その全て無念の集合体とする説もあるわ。: There's also a theory that she's the embodiment of all those tragic souls combined.
m200560.あれだけの大活躍、当然でしょう。\n風紀委員として、情けない限りです。: With a performance that big, it's only natural. As a member of the moral committee, it's just pathetic.
m200560.うん、もうすぐ学園の入学式があるでしょ？\nそのときの新入生歓迎会にどうかなって: Yeah, the entrance ceremony's coming up soon, right? I was thinking we could make it the welcome party for the new students!
m200560.うーんと、説明するのが少し難しいんだけど……。: Hmm… it's a bit hard to explain.
m200560.この学園はすごく自由で、優しくて、\nなんにでも挑戦できる場所なんだって！: This academy is so free, so kind, a place where you can try anything!
m200560.さあ、現時点では分かりようもないわね。\nとにかく今は新入生の安全確保を最優先に:
At this point, we have no clue.
For now, securing the freshmen's safety is our top priority—
m200560.しかし、どうしてそこまでしてエッグパーティを？: But why go to such lengths for an egg party?
m200560.しばらくの間は伏せておくつもりです。\n彼女には先入観を持ってほしくありません。: I'll keep it under wraps for now. I don't want her to form any preconceptions. Just to be safe, I'll tell only Efne.
m200560.そこはほら、特別出張版？ みたいな感じで？: Well, think of it as a special out-of-town edition, something like that?
m200560.そして、最新の記録は今から五十年以上前。\n『赤と白』と呼ばれていた二人組の災厄:
And the latest record is just over fifty years ago.
The pair of calamity witches known as “Red and White” were slain, and they've vanished completely since.
m200560.そんな大物がどうして学園に……。: How on earth did such a big name end up at the academy…?
m200560.だから、後輩の子たちにも知ってほしいんだ。: So I want the younger students to experience that too.
m200560.で、そのリトルなにがしはどんな魔女なんだい？: So, what kind of witch is this “Little …” anyway?
m200560.でも、エッグパーティって世界樹限定のお祭りじゃ？: But aren't egg parties only festivals for the World Tree?
m200560.なるほど、根回しは済んでいるのですね。\nそれなら特に問題はないと思いますが……: I see, the groundwork's already done. In that case I don't think there'll be any problem…
m200560.なーに、これから名誉挽回すればいいだけさ。\nその機会は嫌ってぐらい転がってくる: All we have to do is make a comeback. Opportunities to do that should be rolling in, if anything.
m200560.ひとまずはエスネアに任せるしかないでしょうね。\nその上で、アタシたちは最悪の事:
For now we have to leave it to Esnea.
Beyond that, we should prepare for the worst.
m200560.みんなと出会って、あたしの世界は広がったの。\n毎日が新しくて、一日も退屈なんて: Meeting everyone expanded my world. Every day felt fresh, I never once felt bored.
m200560.エスネアさんも今や学園のスーパースターですからね。\nまあ、想像していた形とはか: Esnea's practically the school's superstar now. Well, it's probably a lot different from what we imagined…
m200560.グリトニアやスィーテンの消息も掴めていないのに……。: And we still have no word on Grittoria or Sweeten…
m200560.世界樹の協力ならすでに取り付けてあります。\n文化交流のためならと快く引き受けて: We've already secured the World Tree's cooperation. They gladly agreed, saying it's for cultural exchange.
m200560.出身・年齢・本名・素性、全てが不明。\n実在すらも確かではないその伝説の魔女を、: Everything about her—origin, age, real name, identity—is unknown. It's not even clear she actually existed. People apparently called that legendary witch with reverence.
m200560.分かりました、そういうことであれば、\n我ら風紀委員も協力は惜しみません。: Understood. If that's the case, we on the disciplinary committee will gladly help.
m200560.夢檻の魔女、ミスワンダーランド、リトルレディ──と。: The Dream-Cage Witch, Miss Wonderland, Little Lady—those are the names.
m200560.学園購買部も同じくです！: The school store feels the same way!
m200560.彼女はまた来ると言っていたぞ、どうする？: He said she'll be back. What do we do?
m200560.悩んでも仕方ねぇ、やれることをやろうや。: Worrying won't help, so let's do what we can.
m200560.新入生の九割が小悪魔ガールズを見守り隊に入ったとか？: Apparently nine out of ten freshmen joined the Little Devil Girls Watch squad.
m200560.新入生歓迎学園エッグパーティ、成功させましょう。: Let's make the new-student welcome academy egg party a success.
m200560.最も恐ろしい災厄の魔女と称されているわ。\n彼女たちはそれぞれが個人で国家規模の:
She's called the most terrifying calamity witch.
Each of them is a disaster on a national scale.
But Little Lady is on a whole different level.
m200560.最古の記述は、六百年前の歴史学者の日記。: The earliest record is a historian's diary from six hundred years ago.
m200560.校庭にウサギさんが入り込んできて、\nみんながメロメロになっちゃったよぉ！: A rabbit hopped onto the schoolyard, and everyone went absolutely bonkers!
m200560.父親の虐待によって冬の日に凍死した少女とも、\n拷問趣味を持った貴族によって攫わ:
Some say she was a girl who froze to death on a winter day after her father's abuse,
others claim she was an orphan kidnapped by a noble with a taste for torture,
and some say she was a child burned at the stake during a witch hunt.
m200560.私たち放課後不思議倶楽部もお忘れなく。: Don't forget us, the After-School Mystery Club.
m200560.間違いないのは、非業の死が生み出した怪物ということ。: One thing's certain: she's a monster born of an untimely death.
m200560.集まってもらったのは他でもないわ。\nあの様子のおかしなタマゴについてよ。: I gathered you all for one reason: that strange egg we've been seeing.
m200560.頭が痛いですね……災厄の魔女すら従える最恐の魔女。: My head hurts… The most terrifying witch who even commands calamity witches.
m200560.魔族のあたしを受け入れてくれた友達。\n馬鹿なあたしに向き合ってくれた先生。: Friends who accepted a demon like me. Teachers who actually faced my foolish self.
m200560.魔法都市の図書館でたまたま調べたことがあるの。\nハンプティ・ダンプティは、とあ: I happened to look it up at the magical city's library. Humpty Dumpty is a familiar of a certain witch.
m200560.（鬼が出るか蛇が出るか、備えねばなりませんね……）: (We need to be ready in case a demon shows up or a snake…)

m300257.――あ、あれ？\n私、こんな所で何を……？:
Ah, what?
What am I doing here…?
m300257.――きゃっ、お、王子、大変！\n向こうからゴブリンの群れが走ってくるわ！: —Whoa, Prince, it's bad! A horde of goblins is charging at us from over there!
m300257.――すみません、この子たちが\n紛らわしいことをしてしまって……。: —I'm sorry, these kids caused some confusion…
m300257.――その記憶の整理が、王子の中では\nまだついていないということなのでしょう。: —It seems his mind hasn't yet finished processing those memories.
m300257.――でも、街の人に怪我をさせないように、\n十分に注意してお祭りを楽しむのよ？:
――But let's be careful not to hurt anyone,
and enjoy the festival safely, okay?
m300257.――なるほど、それは間違いなく悪夢だな。\nそしてタイミングの悪いことに、\nど:
—I see. That is undeniably a nightmare.
And, unfortunately for us,
it seems he has noticed our intrusion.
m300257.――にゃはは、悪いねみんな。\n大掃除まで手伝ってもらっちゃってさぁ。:
Nya-ha-ha, sorry about this, everyone.
I'm making you help me with the big cleaning.
m300257.――はい、満員御礼、拍手喝采、ぽんぽこりん♪\nさぁエルドラちゃん、教えたとおり:
—Alright, the house is full, the applause is thunderous, pon-poko-rin♪
Come on, Eldora-chan, be as energetic as I taught you!
m300257.――はい！\nパレード絶好調ですね！ マッスルですね！\nそういうわけでイリオス:
—Yes!
The parade is going wonderfully! So much muscle!
And so, I'm Ilios!
m300257.――んん？ あれ？ この地脈の秘術って、\n確か魔王と戦った時に展開したものです:
—Hm? Wait, these earth vein arts...
Weren't they the ones deployed when we fought the Demon King?
m300257.――ギャギャ！ マイゴ！ ミツカラナイ！: —Gya gya! My go! Can't find it!
m300257.――ナルホド、雪合戦。\n雪玉ヲ使えバ弾薬を節約デキルとは、\n人間タチもヨク考:
――I see, a snowball fight.
Using snowballs to save on ammunition,
humans certainly think of things.
m300257.――大変大変！\n大変なんです王子さまー！:
――It's an emergency!
It's a big emergency, Prince!
m300257.――王子、報告にあったとおりです。\nゴブリンの集団が大規模演習をしています！:
—Prince, it's just as the report said.
The Goblin horde is conducting a large-scale exercise!
m300257.――破魔矢を、射つのか！？: ――So we're going to shoot the hamaya arrows?
m300257.――肯定。\nしかしいつもどおりだと判断できます。\nいつもどおりとは、とても好:
—Affirmative.
However, I can determine that this is "as usual."
And "as usual" is a very pleasant thing.
m300257.……あれ？ この本は……。\nもしかして召喚術の魔導書……？:
……Huh? This book is…
Could it be a grimoire of summoning magic…?
m300257.……いつもどおりとは……つまりは必定よ。\nこうして……皆が集うのも……のぅ……:
...As usual... meaning, it is inevitable.
For everyone to gather here like this... is...
m300257.……うずうず。\nこれは……実験するしか……！:
……I can't wait.
I have to… experiment!
m300257.……おや？\nでもこいつら、ただのネズミじゃないね。\nワーラットってやつさ。:
……Hm?
But these aren't just ordinary mice.
They're war rats.
m300257.……それなら、仕方ありませんね。\n怪我のないように気をつけるんですよ？:
……If that's the case, I suppose there's no choice.
Just be careful not to get hurt, all right?
m300257.……どうやら、実験好きなのは\n精神支配と関係なかったみたいですね。:
……It seems her love of experimenting
had nothing to do with the mind control.
m300257.……む？ ああ、確かにそうだが――まさか。: ……Hm? Ah, yes, that is correct, but—no, surely not.
m300257.……む？ 実験だと？\nそれにしては、些か邪悪に過ぎる妖気を感じるな。: …Hmm? An experiment, you say? Still, I sense a rather evil… aura.
m300257.……何が起きているのかは分かりませんが、\n向かってくる以上見過ごすことはできま: …I don't know what's happening, but if they're coming at us we can't just ignore it.
m300257.……何だ、パレードとは歩くだけじゃないのか？\nグランプリだ、人気闘兵だと忙しな:
...So the parade isn't just about walking?
Grand Prix, popularity contests... It's quite a whirlwind.
m300257.──あっ、もう一つありました。\n師匠と実験していた、魔王さまの影が作り出せます:
Ah, I almost forgot.
I can create the shadow of the Demon King
that I was experimenting on with my master.
I'll leave the orders to you~.
m300257.──いけません！\n喚び出したキメリエスの眷属が\n彼女に襲い掛かろうとしていま: —That's not allowed! The summoned Kimeries minion is about to attack her!
m300257.あ、甘酒は、ちょっと……そのぉ……。: Ah, sweet rice wine is… well, um…
m300257.あぁっ、魔導書返してくださいー。\n絶対ヤバくて素敵なのが喚び出せますからー。:
Aaah, give me back the grimoire!
I can definitely summon something awesome and dangerous!
m300257.あそこに生えている魔界の花は、\n開花すると近くの生物の生命力を\n奪うと文献で:
I read in the literature that the demonic flowers
growing over there drain the life force
of nearby creatures once they bloom――
m300257.あっ、こ、こらっ！\nそんな勢いで走っていったら……！？: Ah, hey! If you run off like that…!?
m300257.あっ、そろそろ上位入賞の方々が\nこっちの道に進んできますよ！\n王子さま、ほら:
Ah, the top contenders are just about to
come down this way!
Prince, come, come, this is the VIP section♪
m300257.あっちにある宝箱も動いてるように見えるよ……？\nあれ、絶対ミミックでしょ？\n:
That treasure chest over there looks like it's moving, too……?
That's definitely a mimic, right?
The kind that attacks if you touch it?!
m300257.あっ！ よぉーく見ると、\nねずみは同じルートを走ってるみたいです！:
Ah! If you look closely,
the mice seem to be running the same route!
m300257.あの子の戦い方、私たち召喚士と似てるみたい。\n強力な召喚獣だから、\n敵がたく:
That girl fights a lot like us summoners.
She's a powerful summoner, so
it might be best to call her out when there are lots of enemies!
m300257.あの子の才能が計り知れないわ……。\n傍から見てたけど、魔王の影が持つ魔剣なら\:
That girl's talent is beyond measure…
I was watching from the side, but the magic sword the Demon King's shadow wields
should be able to pierce that rigid armor!
m300257.あはは……以前は間違えて\n射っちゃったんですけどね。: Ahaha… I accidentally shot one before, you know.
m300257.あらら、１問間違えちゃいましたわ……。\nでもあと一歩で、竜人族博士ですわよ！:
Oh dear, I got one wrong…….
But I was just one step away from being a Dragon Scholar!
m300257.あららぁ、不正解ですわね……。: Oh my, that is the wrong answer…….
m300257.あららら……。\n残念無念ですわぁ……。:

m300416.おお、久しいな砂漠の女王よ。\nこれは会談に余計な口を挟まぬよう、\n一時的に発:
Ah, it has been a while, Queen of the Sands.

m300416.おお、恐ろしい、恐ろしいことです。\n穏便に話し合いをしたかったのですがね……\:
Oh my, how terrifying.

if that is your wish, then so be it.

Oh, are you worried about him?

Oh, and when placing your investigators,

Oh, Assistant, did you get flustered?

Oh, Assistant, are you nervous?

Oh, so it's Azumi who did it.

Oh, do you need a hint?

m300416.きみはまず、劇毒『懺悔室の雪』を\n寄せ鍋の中に混入させた。\nそしてそれを――:
First, you mixed the deadly poison "Snow of the Confessional"

Kyaa?! Something fell from the ceiling!

Now that you've been assigned to my team,

You're being so noisy and annoying,

Well, since the meal is ready,

Come on, everyone, let's do this!

Don't worry, you can inflict emotional damage from afar!
m300416.しゃあっ！ ついでにチェインソン男も爆散！: Let's do it! Might as well blow the Chainson Man up too!

Hierophant possesses a natural resistance to poison.

Stop with the Halloween stuff right after New Year's!!

And――once she unleashes her power,

m300416.その愚か、誰に向けて言ってます？: Who exactly are you calling foolish?

m300416.その通り。よって考えるべきは、\n『毒入り鍋を五人が食べて、一人だけ死んだのはな:

Exactly. The poison was also detected in the hot pot

A fickle opportunist who jumps from one god to another?

The moment the New Year arrives, it transforms into a festive celebration
overflowing with everyone's smiles.

Well, since everyone's here,

This time, the East is presiding as chairperson──

So, what will it be?

But I imagine we could take a few of you in exchange for ourselves.

So, the two of us tried to enter his dream

but…

Then, once again…….

Still, they were all sharing the same table...

Let's enjoy the New Year's visit to the East together♪

If you could have trusted someone like me…

Then let's have a showdown, Golden Demon!

So what we need to consider is,

Then, once more…

A-Anyway!

H-How barbaric! This is why Eastern savages are……

Look. You can see their shadows on the floor.

Prince, watch the floor carefully.
m300416.ほんとに苦しみなく逝けたのなら、\nせめて、せめて、それだけは救いですの。:
If she truly passed away without suffering,
then at least, at least, that is some comfort.
m300416.ぼくは名探偵アナベラ。騒ぎを聞いて駆け付けたんだ。\nこれより検死を行う――皆は:
I am Detective Anabella. I heard the commotion and came running.
I will now perform an autopsy—please, no one move from here.
m300416.まさか、ワシの自慢のコマが破壊されるとはね……。: To think my prized top would be destroyed...
m300416.まったく、正月から騒がしい……。\nなにを騒いでいるというのかな？:
For goodness' sake, it's so noisy on New Year's...
What is all the commotion about?
m300416.まったく、騒がしいお正月ですね……。: Honestly, what a noisy New Year's...
m300416.み、みなさーん！\n王子の夢の中の、王国軍のみなさーん！！\nたーすーけーてーく:
E-everyone!
The Royal Army in the Prince's dream!
P-Please h-help us!!
m300416.みなさーん。年越しそばの準備ができましたよ。\n食堂へいらしてください。:
Everyone. The New Year's soba is ready.
Please come to the dining hall.
m300416.みんなー！\n今日はアンナの年末ライヴに来てくれて、ありがとー！！:
Everyone!
Thank you so much for coming to Anna's year-end live show!!
m300416.むっ……それは魔界の門開通記念に、\n極少数だけ生産された\n魔神レラジェ様フィ: Hmph…… Is that not the Demon God Leraje figure that was produced in extremely limited quantities to commemorate the opening of the Demon Realm gates?
m300416.も、モーティマさんが\nつるつると床を滑り、右から左へ！？: M-Mortimer is sliding across the slippery floor, from right to left!?
m300416.やがて、ゴブリンとの戦闘が発生。\nパラベルの指揮のもと、バルバストラフは離れた:
Eventually, a battle with goblins broke out.
Under Parabel's command, Barbastroff stayed at a distance,
while the other four grouped together to repel the goblins.
m300416.やだっ！？ 当たると痛いんですよこれぇ……。\nしっしっ！ もうっ、次から次へと:
No way?! They hurt when they hit you…
Shh, shh! Ugh, one thing after another…
m300416.よく遊び、よく食べて、適度な運動をして。\n今年が、平和で健康な一年になるといい:
Play well, eat well, and exercise in moderation.
I hope this year will be a peaceful and healthy one for all of us.
m300416.りょーかい。\n出てくる奴ら、みんな倒せばいいってことね？:
Got it.
So we just need to defeat everyone who shows up, right?
m300416.わっせ、わっせ。はぁ～重たい。\nでも、あたしはつよつよだもんっ！\nこれくらい:
Whoa, whoa. Haa~ it's heavy.
But I'm super strong, you know!
I can carry this much…… Kyaaah!?
m300416.んんん、いえ、これは忘れ物ではなく……。\nほら、見てください。\nこの人形と一: No, no, it's not a lost item……. Look, please. There's a doll here, along with a letter.
m300416.アラン、覚えておくといいですわ。\nしんみりした雰囲気の時にこそ、\nトラブルは:
Aran, you'd better remember this.
Trouble has a way of swooping in
precisely when the atmosphere is most solemn.
m300416.ガンスリンガーのパラベルですの。\n戦いのときに、配置を指示したのはベルですの。:
I am the Gunslinger, Parabel.
I was the one directing the formations during the battle.
m300416.ガンスリンガー・パラベル。\nきみが、バルバストラフを殺した犯人だね？:
Gunslinger Parabel.
You're the one who killed Barbastroff, aren't you?
m300416.ギャギャ……ヤラレゾメ……。\nデモ、オナベノレシピ、アリガト……。:
Gyagya... a tough one...
But, thanks for the nabe recipe...
m300416.コマだけ狙えばいいってわけね！\n新年早々だけど、村を守るために戦うわよ！:
So we just need to target the tops!
It's the start of the New Year, but we'll fight to protect the village!
m300416.ゴブリンの来襲も、きみが仕組んだのだろう。\nそして戦闘の指揮を執るふりをして、:
The goblin raid was your doing, too.
Pretending to command the battle, you guided everyone except the victims
into the range of Elias's healing.
m300416.チェーンソッソッソォッ！！\nもちろん村は直してくぜぇーッ！\n後片付けまでがコ:
CHAIN-SON-SON-SON!!
Of course I'll fix the village, you guys!
Cleaning up is part of the top-spinning game, after all!
m300416.ノストラさんは、猫舌なのですね。\nふーふーして食べるといいと思います。:
It seems Nostra has a sensitivity to hot food.
I think it would be best to blow on it before eating.
m300416.ノストラちゃんはアヅミさんより前へ！\nベルは背後より援護しますの！\nエリアス:
Nostra, move ahead of Azumi!
I'll provide support from the rear!
Elias, please keep the three of us healed!
m300416.ハイエロファントには、毒からの回復を\n促進させる力がある。遅効性であり、潜伏期:
The Hierophant has the power to accelerate recovery from poison. Since it's a slow-acting toxin that's harmless during its incubation period,
he should have been able to neutralize it completely.
m300416.ハイエロファントのエリアスです。\nお鍋をぴかぴかに洗いました。:
I am the Hierophant, Elias.
I washed the pot until it was sparkling clean.
m300416.ハロウィンじゃなくてお正月だろ……！: It's not Halloween, it's the New Year...!
m300416.バルおじいちゃんは、\n離れた位置から補佐をお願いしますの！:
Old Man Barb,
please assist us from a safe distance!
m300416.バルおじいちゃんは、よく遊んでくれましたの。\nこの新年会も、二人で企画しました:
Old Man Bar always played with me.
The two of us planned this New Year's party.
He looked so happy today……
m300416.ベルは、大好きな人が苦しみながら\n死んでいくのを見たくない。\nだから――苦し:
Bell doesn't want to watch someone she loves die in agony.
So――I gave her that poison, so she could pass away without suffering.
m300416.マインさんが地雷をばら撒きながらこちらへ！？\n彼女の地雷の威力は凄まじいです。:
Mine is sliding toward us while scattering mines!
Her mines are incredibly powerful.
Please be careful not to step on any!
m300416.マーチャントのノストラよ。\n食材は私が切ったけど、それが何？:
It's the Merchant, Nostra.
I chopped the ingredients, but what of that?
m300416.ワシは新年を穏やかに祝い、\nまったりと過ごしたいのだがね……。:
I was hoping to celebrate the New Year peacefully
and spend it in a relaxed manner, but...
m300416.ワシも手伝おう。\n修理においてもグレーターデーモンを超えていることを、\n皆に:
I'll lend a hand, too.
Let's show everyone that I'm even better than Greater Demons at repairs.
m300416.ヴァンパイアの姫君よ、\n共にうさぎの暴走を鎮めましょう。:
Princess of the Vampires,
let us quell the rabbits' rampage together.
m300416.一時はどうなることかと思いましたが……。\n無事、完遂できましたね！:
For a moment, I thought things were going to go terribly wrong…
But we managed to finish everything safely!
m300416.不思議ですよね、東の国の初詣というものは。\n普段は静かで、厳かで、とても穏やか:
It's quite a mystery, isn't it, this New Year's tradition of the Eastern lands.
Usually, the shrine is so quiet, solemn, and peaceful, yet――
m300416.久しぶりの再会にとんだ挨拶だな、友よ。\n少しお前に聞いておきたいことがあってな:
A hell of a greeting for a reunion, friend.
I just have a few questions for you.
m300416.人呼んで、『懺悔室の雪』。\nほとんど苦痛なく死に至ることから、\n一部の国では:
They call it "Snow of the Confessional."
Because it leads to death with almost no pain,
it is used for euthanasia in some countries—and for executions.
m300416.今まですみませんでした。: I apologize for my behavior until now.
m300416.今日はなんと、\n魔界からもファンの皆が来てくれています。\n魔界のみんなー！:
Today, we even have fans coming from the Demon Realm.
Everyone from the Demon Realm! Thank you!
m300416.今日は神事の日でもありますから。\nきっと、言葉は通じずとも、\n神聖なこの気配:
Today is also a day of sacred rites.
Even if they don't understand the words,
they must have sensed the holy presence here.
m300416.何かありましたか？\n忘れ物なら受付に届けないと……。: Was something the matter? If it's a lost item, we need to turn it in at the reception…….
m300416.余では些か不足であろうが、\n今回のところは我慢してくれ。:
I may be a step below,
but please bear with me this once.
m300416.偽物だから別に痛くないんでしょ？\n斬られたぐらいでガタガタ言わない！:
It's a fake, so it doesn't hurt, does it?

Stop complaining just because you got cut!
m300416.優しいきみのことだ、断罪する勇気が出ないのだね。\n自らの意思で犯人を指し示すこ:
Being as gentle as you are, you must lack the courage to condemn.
Accusing someone of your own volition comes with a responsibility that can be crushing. I'll take it on.
m300416.出ますか……！\nグレーターデーモン時代に磨いていた、\n超絶爆転コマ回しが……:
You're going to do it...!
That super-explosive top-spinning technique you honed during your Greater Demon days...!
m300416.助手王子さん、証言は聞き終わりましたか？\nバルバストラフさんを殺した犯人は、誰:
Assistant Prince, have you finished hearing the testimonies?
Who is the one who killed Barbastroff?
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m300416.周辺に棲息する野生の魔物も、\n根こそぎ引き寄せられたようです。\nしばらくは、: It appears the wild monsters living in the area were all drawn in as well. The nearby villages should be safe for a while.
m300416.問題ありませんよ。\nこれから掃除をするのですから。\n少々手間が省けたと思えば:
It's no problem.
We're about to start cleaning anyway.
Think of it as saving a bit of effort……, right?
m300416.問題なのは――この中に、\nバルバストラフを殺した犯人が居るということだ。:
The real problem is this—
the person who killed Barbastroph is among us.
m300416.困った男だ、本当に。\nこんな悪夢を見るくらいにあれこれと抱え込んで……。:
He really is a troublesome man.
Carrying all that weight on his shoulders, until he has a nightmare like this…
m300416.大掃除だから仕方ないでしょう。\n神殿に地雷を保管してると聞いた時は、\n驚いち:
It's a year-end cleaning, so it can't be helped.
I was surprised to hear they stored mines in the temple!
And there are this many of them!
m300416.大方、干支交代の神事に引き寄せられて、\n飛び込んできたのでしょう。:
They were likely drawn in by the ritual
marking the change of the zodiac sign.
m300416.奪うというなら、お帰り願おう。\nさあここはひとつ、わしが指揮を――:
If you mean to take it by force, then I shall escort you out.
Very well, let me take command and—
m300416.容疑者の中に、治癒能力のあるクラスの者がいるね。\nその力を利用すれば、解毒は間:
One of the suspects belongs to a class with healing abilities.
If that power had been used, the antidote would have arrived in time.
So then…… who arranged for everyone except the victim to be healed?
m300416.少々破れていますが、調理法はこの紙に。\nアヅミが誰かを手に掛けるとして、\n料:
The recipe is on this paper, though it's a bit worn.
Even if I did kill someone,
I would never use food as a weapon.
m300416.己の祈りや癇癪ひとつで、他者の命に手を掛ける我儘。\n美しいものと見紛いやすくは:
Taking another's life based on your own prayers or tantrums is selfish.
It may look beautiful, but
it's not a virtue to be praised.
m300416.年越しそば！ 毎年密かな楽しみなんですよね。: New Year's soba! It's a little secret joy of mine every year.
m300416.彼だけじゃありません！\n掃除をしていた兵士たちが、\n床の上をつるつる滑り始め:
It's not just him!
The soldiers who were cleaning are
starting to slide around on the floor!
m300416.彼の死因が分かった――飲食に混ぜての毒殺だよ。: I have determined the cause of death—poisoning via food or drink.
m300416.彼らの神はオリュンポス第５層、\nタカマガハラに籠もっているというのに、\nそれ:
Their god is said to be sequestered in Takamagahara,
the fifth layer of Olympus,
and yet they still use their faith as a guide for their daily lives.
m300416.念のためにもう一度言っておくが、\n場所を示すときには、\n姿が隠れていない者に:
Just to be safe, I'll say it again:
when you're pointing out a location,
please make sure you're aiming at someone who's actually visible!
m300416.怪しいと思う者の前に、調査員を配置してみたまえ。\n全員容疑者なのだから、全員へ:
Please place an investigator in front of whoever you suspect.
Since they are all suspects, I recommend questioning every single one of them.
m300416.恐らく親分ミミックだね。\n子分を倒されてお怒りの様子だ。\n強敵だよ。王子、頑:
It's probably the alpha mimic.
It seems angry about losing its minions.
It's a tough enemy. Let's do our best, Prince.
m300416.意外と才能が有ったりして♪\nふふ、モーティマおじさま。一緒にレッスンはいかが？:
He's surprisingly talented♪
Hehe, Uncle Mortimer. How about a lesson together?
m300416.愚問だね。\nさぁ、過酷なコマ回しをはじめるよ。:
A foolish question.
Now then, let us begin this grueling top-spinning match.
m300416.手紙にはなんと？: And what does the letter say?
m300416.改めてようこそ、今は亡き友人から譲り受けた別荘へ。\nそして今日呼んだのは、わし:
Welcome once again to the villa I inherited from my late friend.
And the ones I invited today are those who look after me.
I'm grateful you're spending the New Year with this old man.
m300416.料理人のアヅミでございます。\n食材の調達や調理は、大半をアヅミが行いました。:
I am the Cook, Azumi.
I handled most of the ingredient sourcing and preparation.
m300416.暴れているのは……アルミラージに、\nボーパルバニーでしょうか？:
The ones causing the commotion are... the Almiraj,
and perhaps some Bopal Bunnies?
m300416.最初に「アイドルやりたい」と言い出した時は、\nとうとう過労で、仕事をしながら\:
When you first said you wanted to be an idol,
I thought you were finally starting to dream
while working yourself to death from overwork……
m300416.本来はフェイロンの予定だったのだがな。\n天界との決戦に備えるための首脳会談とな:
Feiron was originally supposed to attend.
But when it comes to a summit to prepare for the decisive battle against the Celestial Realm,
he felt his rank wasn't high enough and begged off.
m300416.村に魔物が出没したと報告を受けて来ましたが、\nあれが噂のチェインソン男ですか…:
We received a report of monsters appearing in the village and came to investigate,
but is that the infamous Chainson Man...?
m300416.東の国のお祭りには、\n屋台や出し物がつきものだと聞いています。\nせっかく来た:
I've heard that festivals in the East
are always accompanied by stalls and entertainment.
Since we've come this far, let's enjoy the people's festival.
m300416.東の民の、大切な初詣。\n私たちで守ってあげませんと。:
The people of the East's precious New Year's visit.
We must protect it.
m300416.死に損ないの鼠風情に世界の運命は変えられぬ。\n神の雷霆に裁かれる日を、首を洗っ:
A half-dead rat like you cannot change the fate of the world.
Wash your neck and await the judgment of the divine thunderbolt.
m300416.気にしない気にしない。\nほら、悪ノリは、できるときに！:
Don't worry about it.
Come on, you've got to ride the wave when you can!
m300416.然るべき機関に、出頭しましょう。\n私があなたを救う方法は、もう、それしかないん:
Let us turn ourselves in to the proper authorities.
That is the only way I can save you now.
m300416.犯人が分かったら、\nアンナ警部にひとこと伝えるんだよ。:
Once you've figured out the culprit,
give Inspector Anna a heads-up.
m300416.生憎と余には生きて果たさねばならん使命がある。\n行くぞ聞忠、我らも役に立つこと:
Unfortunately, I have a mission I must fulfill while I live.

Come, Wen Zhong. It's time we proved our worth.
m300416.異端に教える義理などない。\nいいか、覚えておけよドゥマルデ。\n貴様とは決着を:
I have no obligation to explain myself to a heretic.
Listen well, Domalde.
The day of our reckoning will come.
m300416.異端の徒よ、これは宣戦布告です。\n我ら神聖騎士団は異端審問会を発動します。\n:
Heretic, consider this a declaration of war.

We, the Holy Knights, are convening the Inquisition.

The defendant is the entirety of the material and demon worlds. No exceptions.
m300416.皆さん大掃除お疲れ様です。\nケイティさん、進捗の程はどうですか？:
Everyone, thank you for your hard work on the cleaning.
Katie, how is the progress going?
m300416.皆様、優秀な護衛の方々をお連れのようですから、\n私も拮抗できるだけの兵を入れさ:
I see you have brought excellent guards, everyone.
So I allowed myself to bring a force capable of holding its own.
m300416.相手が泣いて詫びるまでとことん追い回しなさい！\n二度とコマちゃんに手が出せない:
Chase them down until they cry and apologize!

Teach them a lesson so they never lay a hand on Koma-chan again!
m300416.真犯人みたいな口調をやめろ！\nいいかい助手くん、犯人はノストラではない。:
Stop talking like the real culprit!
Now then, Assistant, the culprit is not Nostra.
m300416.石鹸水の拭き取り、地雷の撤去、\nそしてミミックとの戦闘……全て完了しました。:
Wiping down the soap suds, removing the mines,
and fighting the mimics… all done.
m300416.研究で部屋に籠りがちな身として、耳が痛いね。\nぼくも、あの体操に混ぜてもらうと:
As someone who tends to hoard themselves in the lab for research, that hits close to home.
I think I'll join in on that exercise routine too.
m300416.確かに、歌が上手いのは事実です。\nでもそれを趣味の範囲ではなく、\n兵や民の慰: It's true that she's a gifted singer. But thinking of using that talent not just as a hobby, but to comfort the troops and the people…… that's simply——
m300416.神がいても、いなくても、\n人は正しい道を歩んでいける、とか思っています？:
Do you think people can still walk the right path,
regardless of whether gods exist or not?
m300416.神聖騎士団は今、誰の意思で動いている。: Who is currently calling the shots in the Holy Knights?
m300416.私が聞いたところによると、\n毒は鍋に混入しており、それを容疑者全員も食していた:
From what I've gathered,
the poison was mixed into the pot, and all the suspects had eaten from it.
Furthermore, every one of them had the opportunity to poison the pot.
m300416.私が診ます！ 皆さんは、\n座布団を重ねて寝台を作ってください！:
I'll examine him! Everyone,
please stack the cushions to make a bed!
m300416.私の故郷の出汁を使った、特製のめんつゆ。\nたっぷりと味わってくださいね。:
I used dashi from my hometown to make a special broth.
Please enjoy it.
m300416.私の治癒の力があれば、\n毒が身体を蝕み始めるより早く、解毒が間に合ったのに。\: If I had used my healing power, I could have neutralized the poison before it started to take hold. I'm so useless…… I can't forgive the culprit.
m300416.私は、一緒には背負えません。\n暗がりを共に歩むことは、決してできません。:
I cannot carry this burden with you.
I can never walk through the darkness with you.
m300416.移り気な異端審問官など洒落にもならん。\n誇り高き雷神の騎士がよくも堕ちたものだ:
A capricious inquisitor is no laughing matter.

How could a proud knight of the Thunder God stoop so low?
m300416.紅牡丹一座、新春公演！\n『名探偵アナベラ 三白荘の殺人』\nはじまりはじまり～:
The Benibotan Troupe's New Year's performance!
"The Great Detective Anabella: The Murder at Sanbyakuso Villa."
Let the show begin~♪
m300416.落ち着いてください。\nあまり騒ぐと王子が起きてしまいますよ。:
Please calm down.
If you make too much noise, you'll wake the Prince.
m300416.裁判にかけるまでもない、判決は死刑だ。: No trial is necessary. The verdict is death.
m300416.見たところゴールデンデーモンのコマは防御型で、\nチェインソン男のコマは攻撃型で:
From what I can see, the Golden Demon's top is defensive,
while the Chainson Man's is offensive!
However, the spin will slow down over time, and they'll likely stop on their own!
m300416.解決編の時間だ。\nさあ助手くん、「犯人はお前だ」と指し示すんだ！:
It's time for the resolution.
Come on, Assistant, point your finger and say, "You're the one who did it!"
m300416.誰かに、一緒に背負ってほしかった……。: I wanted someone to share the burden with me…
m300416.調査の時間だよ、助手王子くん。\n４人の容疑者の証言を聞き、真犯人を推理するのさ:
It's time for the investigation, Assistant Prince-kun.
Listen to the testimonies of the four suspects and deduce the true culprit.
m300416.起きた後に覚えているかどうかはともかく、\nそういう考え方もできますね。:
Whether he remembers it after waking up is another matter,
but that is one way to look at it.
m300416.退却するゴブリンめらの一匹に、\n寄せ鍋の調理法を渡しておきました。\n彼らもま:
I passed the recipe for the hot pot to one of the retreating Goblins.
I'm sure they'll be gathering around a pot with their comrades, too.
m300416.遅効性の毒により、殺人を犯したのは誰なのか？\n『名探偵アナベラ 三白荘の殺人』:
Who committed murder using a slow-acting poison?
『Detective Anabella: The Murder at Sanhakusou』
――The Decisive Resolution Chapter!
m300416.違う違う！ 止まらないんだってば！！\nだ、誰かぁああ！！ 止め、止めてくれぇ！:
No, no! I can't stop! I'm out of control!
S-someone, help!! Please, stop me!
m300416.闇ギルドに居たときでさえ、噂にしか聞かない物騒な毒。\n随分お詳しいのね、帝国の:
Even when I was in the Dark Guild,
I only heard rumors of such a dangerous poison.
You know a great deal about it, don't you, you earnest Imperial?
m300416.雷神の遺志は未だ死んでいない、とな。: Tell them the will of the Thunder God is not yet dead.
m300416.順調に進んでいますよ。\n残すところは、神殿の床を磨くだけで――。\nあっ！ ク:
It's going smoothly.
All that's left is polishing the temple floor――.
Ah! Chloe! Where do you think you're going?
m300416.高位のヒーラーでございましたか。\nもしエリアスさんの力を受けていたのなら、\n:
So you are a high-ranking Healer.
If Elias had been able to lend his power to her,
perhaps the poison could have been cured.
m300416.魔術師ギルドで周囲の警戒してますが、\n予想通りあちこちから魔物が接近中です。\: The Mage Guild has increased security in the surrounding area, but just as expected, monsters are approaching from all directions. Anna's singing, which attracts monsters, is quite something.
m300416.（……何が正しいのか、\n私も常に考え続けないと、いけませんね）:
(……I must always keep reflecting
on what is truly right)
m300416.（……目的はこの会談を失敗させることかな。\nもしもこの場にいる各国首脳の身に何:
(Is the goal to sabotage this summit?
If anything were to happen to the heads of state present here,
it would become an indelible stain on the kingdom's honor.)
m300416.（あの日、舞台の公演が終わったあと、\nパラベルとエリアスは、二人そろって楽屋で:
(That day, after the stage performance ended,
Parabel and Elias both went to the dressing room and cried their eyes out.
They must have gotten too caught up in the emotion of their acting.)
m300416.（おそろしく完成度の高い、死んだふりだ。\n本当に美しい、こちらが呼吸を忘れてし:
(A remarkably convincing act.
He's so beautiful, in fact, that I almost forgot to breathe……)
m300416.（この状況で責任を感じるなんて、優しい子だ。\n一人だけ洗い物係なのは気になるが:
(Feeling responsible in a situation like this…… she's such a kind soul.
It is a bit odd, though, that she was the only one assigned to wash the dishes……)
m300416.（この繁栄は、\n人々に進むべき道を委ねたからなのでしょうか）:
(Is this prosperity because they
left the path to the people themselves?)
m300416.（これこれ、わしは死体役じゃ。\n話しかけたら駄目じゃろう？ 推理、頑張るのじゃ:
(Yes, yes, I am the corpse.
You mustn't talk to me, now. Do your best with the deduction, won't you?)
m300416.（こんな、善性のひとだから。\nだからベルはこんなにも、あなたのことが――）:
(Because she is so good-hearted.
That is why Bell loves you so much—)
m300416.（だからって、あれを会談に混ぜる？\nやだやだ、いやらしいこと考えるね……）:
(But would you really involve that in a summit?
No way, no way... What a nasty thought...)
m300416.（まずマスクを取らせるべきだと思いますの。\nでも、そういうズレたとこもかわいい:
(I think we should have her take off her mask first.
But that kind of awkwardness is cute, too...)
m300416.（ハルモニア……昔の知り合いと会えて、\nテンションが上がってるのかな……）:
(Harmonia... She seems to be in a good mood,
now that she's reunited with an old acquaintance...)
m300416.（バルバストラフは、皆を見てにこにこしてた。\n髭で作られた沢山のちょうちょ結び:
(Barbastroph was smiling at all of us.
He kept the many bows he had made with his beard
untied for the entire day.)
m300416.（優しさに触れると、泣けてきちゃうよな。\nぼくも、キラキラしたオーラの女の子に:
(It's easy to get teary-eyed when you're touched by kindness.
I once cried when a girl with a sparkling aura
picked up the pen I had dropped.)
m300416.（古ぼけているが、普通のレシピだ。\n言っていることは少し怖いが……）:
(It's old, but it's just a normal recipe.
What she's saying is a little unsettling, though……)
m300416.（台本にない台詞――アドリブだわ。\n生真面目なだけじゃないのね、あのお嬢さん）:
(Lines not in the script—improvisation.
She's not just a stickler for the rules, after all.)
m300416.（本当に仲が良かったのだと、伝わってくる。\n被害者を単身で遊撃にあてたのは、信:
(You can tell they were truly close.
Did he send the victim out on a solo raid out of trust……?)
m300416.（東の国の神々は、人々を見守り、\n介入しないことを決めて、岩戸に籠もった）:
(The gods of the East decided to watch over the people
without interfering, and retreated into the Rock Cave)
m300416.（泣き疲れたパラベルとエリアスは、それから\n鍋をもりもり食べて、少しだけ正月太:
(After crying themselves out, Parabel and Elias
ate their fill of hot pot and apparently gained a little holiday weight.)
m300416.（闇ギルド出身というが、被害者には懐いていたようだ。\n食材を刃物で切るだけで、:
(She's from the Dark Guild, but she clearly liked the victim.
Can you really kill a specific person just by cutting ingredients?)
m300416.３、２、１――ことよろォォォッ！！: Chainson Man & Golden Demon: 3, 2, 1—Here we goooo!!

m400243.――よし、じゃあ教えてやろうか。\nまずあの辺りの海岸だが、海流の影響で、\n満: Alright, here's what I know. That stretch of coast is affected by strong currents, so the tides are wildly unpredictable.
m400243.おっと、それから出撃コストも時間経過じゃ回復しない。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持: Oh, and the deployment cost won't recover over time. Bring someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill, or take the Valkyries with you.
m400243.お前も俺が見込んだ男なら、\n傷つくことを恐れず、\nとにかく魔物をぶっ倒してや: If you're the man I think you are, don't fear getting hurt—just crush those monsters.
m400243.さぁて、それじゃあ戦場に行こうか王子。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だぜ？: Well then, let's head to the battlefield, Prince. The Grand Hunt Mission begins!
m400243.さっきまで陸地だった場所が\n今は海に沈んでる、なんてよくあることさ。: Places that were land a moment ago can be submerged in the sea in an instant—nothing unusual around here.
m400243.さて、さっそくだが本題と行こうか。\n――漁村で頻発してる、魔物の襲撃は知ってる: Now then, let's get straight to the point. Have you heard about the frequent monster raids on the fishing village?
m400243.それからこいつは、あくまで海賊連中の噂話だが、\n海から這い出てくる魔物ども、ど: And this is just a rumor among the pirates, but the monsters that crawl out of the sea don't seem to be just following instinct when they land.
m400243.それから何だっけか、ライフが０になってもクリア、\nそれまでに倒した数がカウント: And remember, even if your life drops to zero you can still clear it—the number of monsters you've slain counts toward your record.
m400243.だがちょっと待ちな。\n海賊ならではの情報ってやつを、\nこうして持ってきてやっ: But hold on a sec. I brought you some pirate-style intel, just like I promised.
m400243.ははっ、さすがは王子だな。\nもう魔物討伐の準備まで整えているとは。: Hah, just as I expected of you, Prince. You've already got the monster-hunting preparations ready.
m400243.まさかとは思うが、\n魔王軍が暗躍している可能性もあるだろ？\n注意しておくに越: It sounds far-fetched, but there's a chance the Demon King's army is pulling the strings. We'd be wise to stay on guard.
m400243.よぉ王子。遅かったじゃないか。\nほら、軍議の時間だぜ？: Hey, Prince. You're late. Come on, it's time for the council meeting.
m400243.よし、じゃあ改めて出撃準備だな。\n今回の戦いは『大討伐ミッション』って形になる: All right, let's get ready to deploy again. I heard from Katie that this battle will be a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400243.沈まない岩場もあるはずだが、\n兵の配置には気をつけることだ。: There should be some rocky outcrops that stay above water, so be careful where you position your troops.
m400243.漁村の連中が腕利きの傭兵を雇って、\n魔物を討伐してもらおうとしたんだが、\n統: The villagers hired skilled mercenaries to take care of the monsters, but they were completely overwhelmed by a well-organized horde.
m400243.漁村の連中の平和を守るのが最優先だからな、\nとにかく『多くの敵を撃破すること』: Protecting the villagers is our top priority, so the key is simply to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400243.ＥＸＰやゴールドも手に入らないが、\n――ハハッ、別に俺達が奪ってるわけじゃない: You won't earn any EXP or gold…—haha, not that we're stealing anything. I'd never chase after petty loot.

m400390.――王子、東の砦より伝令！\n正体不明の魔物の軍勢、さらに増加！: —Prince, a messenger from the eastern fortress! Unidentified monster forces are swelling!
m400390.……それもそうですね。\nあっ……でも、ここだけ微かに読み取れそうです。: …That's true. Ah… but I think I can pick up a faint clue here.
m400390.……どうやら、消耗戦を\n続けろとは言わなくて済みそうね。: …Looks like we can skip telling them to keep grinding this war.
m400390.……なるほど、つまりあの謎の敵対生物は、\n突然、どこかから出現したのだ、と。: …I see. In other words, that mysterious hostile lifeform just appeared out of nowhere.
m400390.あぁ、アルレットさん。\nいえ、どうにも気になることがありまして。: Ah, Arlette. No, there's just something bothering me.
m400390.あぁっ、それはさっき買った焼きたてのー！？: Ah, that's the fresh-baked one I just bought!?
m400390.あっ、それはとっておきの！\n返してくださいよー！: Ah, that's a secret! Give it back!
m400390.あなたは、アイギス神殿防衛部隊の！\n部隊はどうなったのですか！？: You're from the Aegis Temple defense unit! What happened to your forces!?
m400390.あはは、そうそう、その顔♪: Ahaha, there you go, that face♪
m400390.あれが生物なのかどうか、\nその定義から始めないといけないくらい、\nアタシたち: We don't even know if they're even alive, we'd have to start by defining what a "being" is—it's such an alien presence to us...
m400390.あんなものが今までに存在していたのなら、\n必ずどこかに記録が残っているはずだか: If something like that ever existed, there has to be some record of it somewhere.
m400390.いいえ、それがまったく……。\n魔物、事件、伝説、ありとあらゆる資料をあたっても: No, nothing at all... We've scoured every record on monsters, incidents, legends—nothing shows up, which is oddly suspicious.
m400390.これだけの数の魔物――いや、\n魔物かどうかすら分からないわけだが、\nそいつら: That many monsters—actually, we don't even know if they're monsters—where have they been all this time?
m400390.その可能性もありますが……。\nでも、何かが引っかかっているんです。: That's a possibility, but something just feels off.
m400390.それはつまり、確認されていない、\n完全に新種の魔物ということなのでは？: So, you're saying this could be a completely unverified, brand-new species of monster?
m400390.それも何というのか、\n自分で消したかのような痕跡もあって……。: And there's even a trace as if I erased them myself…
m400390.そろそろ反撃ですよぉ……？\nアルレットさんのおやつ、いただきっ！: Time to strike back…? I'll have that snack, Arlette!
m400390.はぁ……分からないってことが分かってしまった。\nこのまま消耗戦を続けろなんて、: *sigh*… I've finally realized we don't even know what we're dealing with. As a strategist, I can't in good conscience tell you to keep grinding this war away.
m400390.ふふん、あんまり気にしてると、\n美味しいお菓子が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞっと♪: Hehe, if you worry about it too much, your tasty snacks will lose their flavor♪
m400390.ぶっちゃけ何も分からない！\nあえて記録を残さなかったんじゃないかって、\n疑い: Honestly, we have zero clues! It makes you wonder if they deliberately left no records, because there's just no information.
m400390.むぅ、自分の癖くらい分かりますよ。\nこの消し方は間違いなく、自分自身のものです: Mmm, I know my own habits. This way of erasing is definitely my own.
m400390.もしやと思い、古代文明の資料や、\n専門家にもあたってみたのですが……。: I even checked ancient civilization documents and consulted experts...
m400390.もっと悪い事態になったかもしれないけどね。\n若！ アイギス神殿の偵察に向かおう: It could've gotten even worse, you know. Young one! Let's head out to scout the Aegis Temple!!
m400390.アイギス神殿防衛部隊からの連絡途絶！\n魔術師ギルドによる通信魔法にも応答ありま: Communications are down from the Aegis Temple defense unit! Even the mage guild's transmission magic gets no response!
m400390.イタズラで、誰かに消されちゃったとか？: Did someone prank you and delete them?
m400390.エフトラ、エフトラかぁ……。\nふふ、ちょっと神秘的で、かわいい名前だね。: Eftra, Eftra, huh… Hehe, it's a mysterious and cute name.
m400390.レーヴさん、書庫に何か\n参考になりそうな資料はありましたか？: Reve, did you find anything useful in the archives?
m400390.何かあったし、それを覚えていない、\nでも、きっとそれは悪いことではなかったんじ: Something happened and you don't remember, but it probably wasn't bad, right?
m400390.名前、なんでしょうか……？\nうーん、うーん？: What does the name mean…? Hmm, hmm?
m400390.報告いたします。\nアイギス神殿北の山脈が崩壊！\n巨大な……その……なんという: Report: The northern mountain range of the Aegis Temple has collapsed! A massive… uh… how should I put it…
m400390.悪いことが起きてたなら、\nこんな風におしゃべり出来ていないだろうし。: If something terrible had occurred, we wouldn't be chatting like this.
m400390.敵はいったい何者なんだ……。\n見たこともない魔物の群れに、\nそれを生み出す能: Who the hell are these enemies... A horde of monsters we've never seen, and the ability that creates them—information is all over the place!
m400390.確かにつけていたはずの日記が、\nほんの数行、なぜか抜け落ちているんです。: The diary I was keeping is missing a few lines, for some reason.
m400390.被害は甚大ですが、まだ持ちこたえています。\nしかしそれも時間の問題かと……。: The damage is severe, but we're still holding on. Though it's only a matter of time…
m400390.超巨大生物の頭部と思われるものが\n山脈を割って出現しました……！！: Something that looks like the head of a colossal creature has torn through the mountains and emerged…!!
m400390.青白い肌と、生物の常識を無視した肉体、\nそして自身を複製するあの特性……。: Pale blue skin, a body that defies all biological logic, and that ability to replicate itself...
m400390.（……忘れているだけでなく、\n自ら消した痕跡があるということは、\nきっと誰か: (Not only have I forgotten, but there's evidence I erased it myself—someone must've done a massive memory tampering…)
m400390.（でも、悪い気はしないですね。\nアルレットさんの言うとおり、\nきっと何か、良: (But it doesn't feel bad. Like Arlette said, maybe it was a good encounter.)

m400435.――それから王子よ、どうにもきな臭い噂を耳にした。\nこの件で亜神ディアスが動い:
—And, Prince, I've caught wind of some rather nasty rumors.
Dias, the demigod, may be getting involved in this!
Even against unknown threats, never let your guard down!!
m400435.――ほう、魔王城へ向かうのか。\nかつての戦場に再び立つ戦士、心が踊るなッ！！: ――Ah, heading to the Demon King's Castle, are we? A warrior standing again on the old battlefield—my heart's racing!!
m400435.……これは、激戦になりそうですねぇ。: …Looks like this'll turn into a fierce battle.
m400435.……ところで、魔王城の財宝は、\nこっそり大胆に盗んじゃってもいいのか？: …By the way, can we just sneakily and boldly steal the castle's treasure?
m400435.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となりますから、\n敵の討伐を優先し、\n魔王城内: Since it's “clear even if your life hits zero,” focus on defeating enemies and thin out the castle's forces as much as you can.
m400435.「援軍要請」のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワルキューレのような兵科を\n出撃メンバーに: I recommend adding troops with the “Request Reinforcements” skill or units like Valkyries to your deployment.
m400435.えぇ、今回は敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を得ることはできないでし: Yeah, I don't think you'll get any EXP, gold, or drops even if you defeat the enemies this time…
m400435.それも抜かりなく♪\nデモシェフ商会の方々が先遣隊として、\n魔界の様子を調査し: We've got it covered♪ The Demochef Trading Company sent a vanguard to scout the demon realm!
m400435.ただ城内には、ガリウスを信奉する、\n多数のデーモンが彷徨っているとのことで……: But inside the castle, countless demons who worship Garius are said to be wandering…
m400435.つまりこの戦いは、神の楔捜索隊のため、\n出来るだけ多くの『敵を倒すこと』を\n: So this fight is a mission for the Divine Wedge search team—to eliminate as many enemies as possible!
m400435.ふむ……それで、\n魔王城の現在地は分かっているのか？\n闇雲に魔界に突入するわ: I see… then, do we know its current location? We can't just charge blindly into the demon realm!
m400435.まぁ、知っていたとしても、\n決戦後に回収できたとは思えないが。: Well, even if we knew, I doubt we could've retrieved it after the final battle.
m400435.また、今回は特殊な作戦ですから、\n時間経過で出撃コストが回復しません。: Also, this is a special operation—your deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400435.むっ……それはすまんなッ！\nしかしまさか、魔王城に神の楔があるとは……！: Hmm… my apologies! But to think the Demon King's Castle holds the Divine Wedge…!
m400435.ガオレオンさま、声が大きいですよぉっ！\n執務室が壊れちゃいますぅぅ！: Lord Gaoleon, you're being so loud! It'll wreck the office!
m400435.同時に、魔王城の調査も兼ねていますから、\n討伐数もすべて記録されていきます。: At the same time, we're also investigating the castle, so every kill will be logged.
m400435.敵が数で押してくるなら、\n全部倒せば良いって話だろ？\n今までやってきた事じゃ: If the enemy's just coming at us in numbers, we just take them all down, right? That's what we've always done.
m400435.決戦後まもなくして、\n魔王城は魔界へ沈んでいってしまいましたからね。: Shortly after the final battle, the Demon King's Castle sank back into the demon realm.
m400435.自軍の被害を怖れるなってことね。\nふふっ、私たちらしくて良いんじゃない？: Don't worry about our own casualties. Hehe, that's just like us, right?
m400435.連中によれば、魔王城には未だ、\nガリウスを討った時の、三女神の力が残っているら: According to them, the castle still retains the power of the Three Goddesses from when we defeated Garius, so it's untouched by the realm's miasma.
m400435.魔王城は魔王ガリウスが作り出した要塞だからな……。\n財宝なんてどこにもないと思: The castle's a fortress built by Demon King Garius… I doubt there's any treasure to speak of.

m400524.――くっ、予を誰だと思っている！\nえぇい、離れろ！ 不敬だと思わぬか！:
— Hah, who do you think I am!
Hey, get back! Don't you think that's disrespectful!
m400524.――くふふ、苦戦しておるようじゃな。: Heh heh, looks like you're struggling.
m400524.――そうか、これは偽りの世界。\n我が身は魔力の歪みがもたらした、\nいっときの: ...I see, this is a false world. My form is just a fleeting illusion brought on by a distortion of magic.
m400524.――はい？\n兜とモンスター娘さんのコピーが暴れている、ですか？:
— Huh?
So copies of the helmet and the monster girl are running amok?
m400524.――ふふふ、妾に挑んでくるとは。\n敵の雑兵たちも見事な心意気である！:
???: ――Heh heh, you dare challenge me.
Even the enemy grunts have spirit!
m400524.――ま、待たれよ！\n予にもその調査、手伝わせてくれまいか！:
—W-wait a moment!
Let me help with that investigation, too!
m400524.――王子、魔物の出現原因が分かりました。\nどうやらこの奥に発生した、\n時空の:
— Prince, we've identified the cause of the monster appearances.
It seems the spacetime distortion that formed deeper inside is linking to another location.
m400524.――第六天黒竜魔王娘マウロの姿だよ！！: "—Behold the form of the Sixth Heaven Black Dragon Demon King Daughter, Mauro!!"
m400524.……ああ、そうだな。\n所領にいる城娘たちも、中々の個性の持ち主だったか。: ...yeah, that's right. Even the castle maidens in my domain had quite the personalities.
m400524.……あの娘は、いつもあんな調子なのか？: …Does that girl always act like that?
m400524.……くっ、きりがない。\nソレイアだったか、助言感謝する。:
…Ugh, it's endless.
If it was Soleia, thanks for the advice.
m400524.……さすがに、手を結んだ相手が、\n強大な力に耐えきれずに弾け飛ぶとか、\n寝覚: "…Even so, teaming up with someone whose power explodes and flings them away… that's a rough way to wake up…"
m400524.……それって、どちらも異世界由来よね？\nまさか、アイギス神殿が異世界に繋がって:
…Both of those are from another world, right?
Could it be that the Aegis Temple is linked to another dimension?
m400524.……ま、まおーじょー、ですか？\n変わったお名前ですね……。\nではマオージョー: ...Maōjō, is it? That's an unusual name... Then I'll call you Mr. Maōjō.
